item.title: 26 housing commencements in Donegal last month
item.description: 26 housing units commenced in Donegal last month an increase of four on January 2025. Nationally, 2,046 units were commenced representing a 73% increase year on year. The area where the most units commenced last month was in Waterford City and County at 409.
